title: RayCAD workpiece material
description: One workpiece material of a library, the file materials/<uuid>.material.json (PLAN.md 3.6, libraries.h Material). Cutting data for it lives in the tools' presets, which name its id. Unknown keys are allowed and are kept when RayCAD saves the material again.

schema.description: Version of this file's format. A larger value means a newer RayCAD wrote it.

specificCuttingForce.description: Specific cutting force kc1.1 in N/mm2, for power and torque estimates (0: not known).
